name: echoes-of-aethelgard
description: Echoes of Aethelgard: The Unraveling — a time-loop RPG for the browser.

scripts.preview: npm run build && node tools/serve.mjs dist 4173 --base /Aethelgard/
scripts.sim: node -e "console.log('sim: STUB (exit 0) - src/sim/cli.ts lands in the sim units (PLAN 7); then: bun src/sim/cli.ts run --seeds 20 --bots melee,caster --classes all')"
scripts.sim:balance: node -e "console.log('sim:balance: STUB (exit 0) - then: bun src/sim/cli.ts batch --seeds 400 --bots all --classes all --out docs/BALANCE.md')"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @smoke
